LanguageData.CC_SetTip_AlmanacTextSize: How large the Almanac's pages are written: their text, headings and tables. The same as the Aa buttons at the top of the Almanac. Small fits more on a page; Large and Larger are easier on the eyes. Wide tables turn into a card for each row when they no longer fit.
LanguageData.CC_TextSize_Small_Tip: A little smaller than the game's own text, to fit more on a page.
LanguageData.CC_TextSize_Normal_Tip: The same size as the game's own text.
LanguageData.CC_TextSize_Large_Tip: A size larger than the game's own text.
LanguageData.CC_TextSize_Larger_Tip: Two sizes larger than the game's own text. Fold the page list away to give wide tables room.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_TextSize_Small: The Almanac's pages a little smaller than the game's text, to fit more on a page.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_TextSize_Normal: The Almanac's pages at the game's usual text size.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_TextSize_Large: The Almanac's pages a size larger than the game's text.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_TextSize_Larger: The Almanac's pages two sizes larger; wide tables turn into cards sooner.
LanguageData.CC_Almanac_TextSizeNote: How large the pages are written. Also in the mod settings, on the Interface page.
LanguageData.CC_Almanac_Fold: Fold the categories and the page list away, so the page gets the whole width.
LanguageData.CC_Almanac_Unfold: Show the categories and the page list again.
